symptoms: 通常无症状；可发热、乏力，免疫低下者可累及器官。

transmission: 唾液、尿液等体液，母婴传播及移植相关传播。
Bodily fluids, maternal transmission and transplant-related transmission.
risk: 先天感染相关听力损失；免疫低下者严重器官疾病。
Congenital hearing loss and serious organ disease in immunocompromised people.
prevention: 减少接触幼儿唾液和尿液，做好手卫生。
Reduce exposure to young children’s saliva/urine and practice hand hygiene.
treatment: 健康者通常不需治疗；部分先天感染或免疫低下患者需抗病毒药。
Healthy people usually need no therapy; selected congenital or immunocompromised cases need antivirals.
mechanism: 终身潜伏、再激活；胎内感染可影响发育。
Lifelong latency and reactivation; prenatal infection may impair development.
progress: 已建立：部分有症状先天感染可从抗病毒治疗获益，需监测副作用。
Established: selected symptomatic congenital cases benefit from antivirals, with toxicity monitoring.
future: 编辑归纳：母婴预防、早期识别和长期听力随访。
Editorial priorities: maternal prevention, early detection and long-term hearing follow-up.

Cervical and other anogenital or oropharyngeal cancers.
prevention: 接种疫苗，按建议筛查；安全性行为降低风险。
Vaccination, recommended screening and safer sex.
treatment: 治疗疣、癌前病变或癌症；没有清除所有HPV感染的药物。
Treat warts, precancer or cancer; no medicine eradicates all HPV infections.

Persistent high-risk infection can disrupt growth regulation and lead to precancer.
progress: 已建立：预防疫苗与筛查共同支持宫颈癌消除。
Established: preventive vaccination and screening support cervical cancer elimination.
future: 编辑归纳：覆盖公平、筛查可及性和治疗性干预。

Respiratory particles, blood and maternal–fetal transmission.

prevention: 呼吸与手卫生；孕期暴露咨询医生。
Respiratory/hand hygiene and clinician advice after pregnancy exposure.
treatment: 轻症对症支持；严重贫血或孕期感染需专科处理。
Supportive care for mild disease; specialist management for severe anemia or pregnancy infection.
mechanism: 感染影响红细胞生成，部分症状与免疫反应有关。
Infection affects red-cell production; immune responses contribute to some symptoms.

Established: no routine vaccine; identify high-risk exposures and complications.
future: 编辑归纳：孕期筛查策略、高风险随访和预防工具。
Editorial priorities: pregnancy screening strategies, high-risk follow-up and preventive tools.

Vaccination, safe water, food hygiene and handwashing.

pathogen: HBV，引起急性或慢性乙型肝炎。
HBV causes acute or chronic hepatitis B.
genome: 部分双链环状 DNA；复制涉及逆转录。
Partially double-stranded circular DNA; replication involves reverse transcription.
structure: 有包膜、二十面体核衣壳。
Enveloped virion with an icosahedral nucleocapsid.
receptor: NTCP 是已确认的肝细胞进入受体。
NTCP is an established hepatocyte entry receptor.
symptoms: 常无症状；可有乏力、恶心和黄疸。
Often silent; fatigue, nausea and jaundice may occur.
transmission: 血液、性接触及母婴传播。
Blood exposure, sexual contact and perinatal transmission.
risk: 肝硬化、肝癌及肝衰竭。
Cirrhosis, liver cancer and liver failure.
prevention: 疫苗、出生剂次、孕期筛查和安全注射。
Vaccination, birth dose, antenatal screening and safe injections.
treatment: 慢性患者可用核苷（酸）类似物抑制病毒；通常需长期管理。
Antivirals suppress chronic infection; long-term management is commonly needed.
mechanism: 肝细胞内持续性病毒储存与免疫损伤维持慢性病程。
Persistent viral templates and immune injury sustain chronic liver disease.
progress: WHO 已更新筛查和扩大治疗适用人群的指导。
WHO has updated guidance on testing and expanded treatment eligibility.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：持续缓解、肝癌预防及诊疗可及性。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Durable remission, cancer prevention and equitable access to care.

pathogen: HCV，引起急性或慢性丙型肝炎。

receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。

Often silent for years; fatigue, nausea and jaundice can occur.
transmission: 主要经血液；也可围产期或经有血液暴露的性接触传播。
Mainly bloodborne; perinatal and blood-associated sexual transmission can occur.
risk: 肝硬化和肝细胞癌。
Cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
prevention: 血液筛查、安全注射和减害服务；尚无有效疫苗。
Blood screening, safe injections and harm reduction; no effective vaccine.
treatment: 直接作用抗病毒药可治愈绝大多数感染者。
Direct-acting antivirals cure most infections.
mechanism: 持续肝脏感染引发慢性炎症与纤维化。
Persistent liver infection causes inflammation and fibrosis.
progress: 可治愈治疗已建立，但诊断与治疗覆盖仍不足。
Curative therapy is established, but testing and treatment gaps persist.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：扩大检测、预防再感染及建立有效疫苗。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Expand diagnosis, prevent reinfection and develop effective vaccines.

pathogen: HDV；人体感染依赖伴随 HBV 感染。
HDV; human infection depends on accompanying HBV infection.
structure: 核糖核蛋白外包裹 HBV 来源的包膜。
Ribonucleoprotein enclosed in an HBV-derived envelope.
receptor: 本概览未核实具体受体；不能据此推断不存在受体。

symptoms: 乏力、恶心、黄疸，可有严重肝炎。
Fatigue, nausea and jaundice; severe hepatitis is possible.
transmission: 血液和体液；性传播，母婴传播较少。
Blood and body fluids, sexual contact; perinatal transmission is less common.
risk: 重症肝炎、快速进展的肝硬化及肝癌。
Severe hepatitis, rapidly progressive cirrhosis and liver cancer.
prevention: 乙肝疫苗可预防未感染 HBV 者的丁肝；已感染 HBV 者不因此获保护。
HBV vaccination prevents HDV in HBV-uninfected people, not existing HBV carriers.
treatment: 专科治疗；干扰素及部分地区获批的布来维肽。
Specialist care: interferon and bulevirtide where approved.
mechanism: 在 HBV 背景下加重肝脏炎症；严重化机制仍不完全清楚。
HDV aggravates HBV-associated liver injury; severity mechanisms remain incompletely understood.
progress: 欧洲已有新疗法获批；疗程及联合方案仍在评估。
New therapy is approved in Europe; duration and combinations remain under evaluation.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：改善诊断可及性和长期治疗结局。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Improve diagnosis and long-term treatment outcomes.

Severe disease in pregnancy; chronic infection in immunosuppressed people.

Liver infection causes inflammation; host status affects clearance and severity.
progress: 已有疫苗用于部分地区及暴发应对。
A vaccine is used in some settings and outbreak responses.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：妊娠保护、慢性病例管理及扩大疫苗证据。

HIV-1 and HIV-2; untreated infection can lead to AIDS.
genome: 两份正链 RNA，经过 DNA 中间体复制。
Two positive-sense RNA copies; replication uses a DNA intermediate.

CD4 and the coreceptors CCR5 or CXCR4 support entry.
symptoms: 急性期类似流感，随后可长期无症状。
Acute flu-like illness, followed by a potentially long silent period.
transmission: 性接触、血液、妊娠、分娩和哺乳；不经普通接触传播。
Sex, blood, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding; not casual contact.
risk: 免疫缺陷、机会性感染及相关肿瘤。
Immunodeficiency, opportunistic infections and associated cancers.
prevention: 安全性行为、PrEP/PEP、无菌针具及有效治疗。
Safer sex, PrEP/PEP, sterile needles and effective treatment.
treatment: 联合抗逆转录病毒治疗；持续病毒抑制可防止性传播。
Combination ART; sustained viral suppression prevents sexual transmission.
mechanism: 感染免疫细胞并形成持续感染，逐渐损害免疫防御。
Persistent infection of immune cells progressively weakens immune defence.
progress: 治疗已使 HIV 成为可管理的慢性疾病。
Treatment has made HIV a manageable chronic condition.
future: 研究重点建议（编辑综合）：持久缓解、预防工具可及性及减少污名。
Suggested priorities (editorial synthesis): Durable remission, prevention access and reduction of stigma.

Adult T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma and progressive myelopathy.

Repeated infections occur across types; duration of protective immunity remains uncertain.
